phase_prompt.summary: Base cinematic scene of the eastern Eritrean coast with ancient-tech vessel.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic depiction of the eastern coast of the Sea of Eritrea at twilight, featuring a massive ancient-tech vessel anchored near jagged limestone cliffs. The vessel's hull is a composite of weathered basalt and translucent crystalline panels etched with luminous glyphs that pulse in soft azure. Bioluminescent plankton in the deep blue sea creates a faint phosphorescent haze, while towering basalt monoliths rise from the shoreline, carved with intricate Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs fused with advanced circuitry glowing faintly. Low, diffused light from a setting sun reflects off the water, casting dramatic long shadows across the scene, evoking a sense of industrial mysticism and grounded realism.
